params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the Group.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The ID for the next page of results.

params.name: from
params.description: The start date (inclusive) of the audit logs search. If not specified, the start of yesterday is used. Dates should be formatted as RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-02T16:30:00Z.

params.name: to
params.description: The end date (exclusive) of the audit logs search. Dates should be formatted as RFC3339, e.g. 2024-01-02T16:30:00Z.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Order in which results are returned.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Filter logs by user ID.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Filter logs by project ID.

params.name: events
params.description: Filter logs by event types, cannot be used in conjunction with exclude_events parameter.

params.name: exclude_events
params.description: Exclude event types from results, cannot be used in conjunctions with events parameter.

items.docs:
Search audit logs for a Group. "api.access" events are omitted from results unless explicitly requested using the events parameter. Some Organization level events are supported as well as the following
Group level events:
  - api.access
  - group.cloud_config.settings.edit
  - group.create
  - group.delete
  - group.edit
  - group.notification_settings.edit
  - group.org.add
  - group.org.remove
  - group.policy.create
  - group.policy.delete
  - group.policy.edit
  - group.request_access_settin
